blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了令人印象深刻的进展,但现有的向导大型立体重建模型产生了一个单一的不可撤销的预测. 当这些模型失败时,没有纠正其错误的机制. 为了解决这一限制,我们引入了Click3R,这是一个使用人类微小的对应点击,对向导模型进行交互几何校正的框架. 鉴于一个图像对和用户提供的一小组交叉视图点对应,Click3R通过一个轻量级点对应适配器将几何限制注入了3D重建网络,使模型能够在重复的纹理,对称结构,大视角变化,或无纹理区域等具有挑战性的情景中解决模糊. 为了评价交互式重建,我们研究了一个具有挑战性的基准,专门用来揭露现有三维反馈重建方法的失败模式。 实验显示,Click3R减少重建出错,以尽可能少的单个函证点击方式,提高了标准及我们所制定的基准的性能. 我们的成果突出表明,人与人之间有限的互动为纠正几何重建错误提供了一个有效而实际的机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Feed-forward stereo 3D reconstruction methods [ 44 , 16 , 29 , 49 ] have transformed multi-view geometry by replacing iterative optimization [ 25 , 34 ] with direct regression.
Given two images, these models predict dense 3D pointmaps in a single forward pass, achieving remarkable speed and generalization across diverse scenes.
This paradigm has recently been extended to multi-view settings [ 42 , 45 , 53 , 40 , 3 ] .
Despite their impressive performance, the efficiency comes at a fundamental cost: when the prediction is wrong, there is no simple mechanism to correct it. Unlike optimization-based methods [ 34 ] that iteratively refine their estimates using geometric constraints, feed-forward models produce a single, irrevocable output and fail silently, particularly on challenging scenes with repetitive textures, symmetric structures, or extreme viewpoint changes (Fig. 1 a,b).
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward立体声3D重建方法[44,16,29,49]通过将迭代优化[25,34]替换为直接回归来转变多景几何.
鉴于有两种相片,这些模型在单个前行通道中预测出密集的3D点图,实现显著的速度并跨出不同的场景进行通俗化.
这一范式最近被推广到多景环境[42,45,53,40,3].
尽管其表现令人印象深刻,但效率却以根本的代价来产生:当预测错误时,没有简单的机制来纠正. 与以优化为基础的方法[34],即利用几何限制来迭代地完善其估计值的方法不同,feed-forward models产生单一的,不可撤销的输出并静默地失败,特别是在具有重复纹理,对称结构,或极端观点变化等具有挑战性的场景(图1 a,b).

blocks.en:
Several approaches aim to improve the reliability of feed-forward reconstruction models through test-time optimization [ 24 , 5 ] .
For instance, LoRA3D [ 24 ] introduces a self-calibration pipeline that fine-tunes a pretrained DUSt3R model [ 44 ] to a target scene.
Although these methods improve performance, iterative test-time optimization is computationally expensive and, more importantly, cannot resolve failures when the model encounters genuinely ambiguous scenes at inference time.
Another line of work improves robustness by incorporating auxiliary geometric priors.
For example, Pow3R [ 10 ] shows that conditioning on camera intrinsics, relative camera poses, or depth maps can significantly improve reconstruction performance.
However, such auxiliary information is often unavailable in practice.
Meanwhile, classical reconstruction methods have long relied on explicit correspondences as geometric constraints [ 34 , 31 , 22 ] .
Unfortunately, automatically estimated correspondences remain unreliable in scenarios with repetitive textures or large viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh:
几种方法旨在通过测试时间优化[24,5]提高饲料前置重建模型的可靠性.
例如,LORA3D[24]引入了自校管,将预训的DUST3R型号[44]微调到目标场景.
虽然这些方法改善了性能,但迭代测试时间优化在计算上成本很高,更重要的是,当模型在推断时间遇到真正模糊的场景时,无法解决故障.
另一行工作通过纳入辅助几何前缀来提高稳健性.
例如,Pow3R [10] 显示,在相机内在,相机相机相位或深度图上进行配置可以显著地改善重建性能.
然而,在实践中往往得不到这种辅助信息。
同时,古典重建方法长期以来一直依赖明确的函证作为几何限制[34,31,22].
不幸的是,在重复的纹理或大视角变化的情况下,自动估计的函证仍然不可靠。

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, cross-view correspondences, even just a handful of point pairs, carry powerful geometric information: they constrain the epipolar geometry, resolve depth ambiguities, and disambiguate symmetric structures.
This motivates a simple question: can sparse human-provided correspondences guide feed-forward 3D reconstruction models without sacrificing the efficiency of the feed-forward paradigm? Instead of relying solely on feed-forward models or automatically estimated correspondences, we allow the user to manually provide a small set of cross-view point correspondences (Fig. 1 a),
when the model produces unsatisfactory reconstructions.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,交叉取景的对应,甚至只是一对小分点的对应,都携带了强大的几何信息:它们制约了地极几何,解决了深度模糊,使对称结构脱节.
这引发了一个简单的问题:人类提供的通信能否在不牺牲向导模式效率的情况下指导向导3D重建模式? 我们不只依靠feed-forward模式或自动估计的函证,而是允许用户手动提供一组小的交叉取景点函证(图1a),
当模型产生不令人满意的重建。

blocks.en:
To unlock this capability, we introduce Click3R , a lightweight framework that incorporates user-provided correspondences into feed-forward 3D reconstruction, enabling interactive geometric correction without test-time model fine-tuning or optimization .
Specifically, Click3R employs a simple correspondence adapter that injects the geometric constraints imposed by user clicks into the reconstruction network via a cross-attention mechanism (Fig. 2 ).
We train the base model and the adapter jointly end-to-end on widely used 3D datasets [ 28 , 2 , 57 ] using simulated human clicks.
During training, the number of clicks is randomly sampled to expose the model to varying levels of user interaction, enabling it to operate under different levels of click sparsity at test time.
blocks.zh:
为了解锁这一能力,我们引入了Click3R,这个轻量级框架将用户提供的通信纳入到向导的3D重建中,使得交互几何校正无需测试时间模型微调或优化.
特别是,点击3 R使用一个简单的函文适配器,通过交叉切入机制(图2 )将用户点击后所施加的几何限制注入重建网络中.
我们利用模拟的人类点击,在被广泛使用的3D数据集[28,2,57]上,对基准模型和适配器进行联合端到端的训练.
在训练期间,点击次数被随机抽取,以将模型暴露于不同级别的用户互动中,使其能够在测试时在不同级别的点击相接性下运行.

blocks.en:
To systematically evaluate the proposed interactive reconstruction, we further introduce Hard3DBench , a benchmark designed to expose failure modes of state-of-the-art feed-forward reconstruction models.
The benchmark contains image pairs and 5-view tuples with ground-truth 3D reconstructions, exhibiting challenging conditions (large viewpoint changes, low overlap, large baselines, extreme depth ranges) where feed-forward reconstruction models often struggle.
Our experiments demonstrate that Click3R consistently outperforms baseline methods, particularly on challenging scenarios from Hard3DBench (Fig. 1 c).
blocks.zh:
为了系统地评价提议的交互式重建,我们进一步引入了Hard3DBench,这个基准旨在揭露最先进的信息传输重建模式的失败模式。
基准包含图像对和5-视图的tuple,与地上真实的3D重建,呈现出具有挑战性的条件(大视角变化,低重叠,大基线,极端深度范围),而向导的重建模式往往在其中挣扎.
我们的实验表明,Click3R的绩效一贯高于基线方法,特别是在Hard3DBench(图1c)提出的具有挑战性的情景上。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose Click3R , which injects sparse human correspondence clicks into feed-forward stereo 3D reconstruction networks via a lightweight correspondence adapter. • We curate Hard3DBench, a diagnostic benchmark with a detailed failure taxonomy under which current feed-forward reconstruction models degrade substantially relative to standard evaluation samples. • We show that Click3R dramatically improves reconstruction accuracy on challenging cases.
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work on interactive stereo feed-forward 3D reconstruction using sparse correspondence clicks.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议使用Click3R,它通过一个轻量级的通信适配器,将稀有的人类通信点击器注入向后传输的立体声3D重建网络。 我们管理Hard3DBennch,这是详细的故障分类法的诊断基准,根据该分类法,与标准评价样本相比,目前的饲料前向重建模型会大量退化。 我们显示,Click3R在挑战性案件中大大提高了重建的准确性.
以我们所知,这是第一个使用微小的相干点击进行交互式立体声前导3D重建的作品.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
DUSt3R [ 44 ] pioneered dense 3D pointmap regression from image pairs using a CroCo-pretrained [ 48 , 47 ] ViT encoder-decoder, bypassing explicit matching and triangulation.
MASt3R [ 16 ] extended this with dense local feature heads.
The paradigm has rapidly advanced toward multi-view: Spann3R [ 41 ] and MUSt3R [ 3 ] use spatial memory across frames; CUT3R [ 43 ] employs a recurrent model with persistent state; Fast3R [ 53 ] scales to 1000+ images in a single forward pass; and VGGT [ 42 ] and Pi3 [ 45 ] predict from arbitrary views with a single Transformer.
Despite their diversity, all these methods rely solely on learned visual priors and cannot incorporate external geometric evidence at inference.
Our work is orthogonal: Click3R augments feed-forward stereo reconstruction with sparse correspondence guidance.
blocks.zh:
DUST3R [44] 率先从图像对上用CroCo-Pretrained [48,47] ViT编码器-解码器进行密集的3D点映射回归,绕过明确匹配和三角.
MAT3R [16] 以密集的本地特色头来扩展此功能.
该范式已迅速向多视图发展: Spann3R [41]和MUSt3R [3]使用跨帧空间内存; CUT3R [43] 使用一个具有持久性状态的反复出现模型; Fast3R [53] 比例尺为1000+图像在一个单一前传; VGGT [42]和Pi3 [45] 从任意观点中用一个单一变形器预测.
尽管这些方法各有不同,但所有这些方法都只依靠所学的视觉前科,不能在推论中融入外相几何证据.
我们的工作是正交的: Click3R 以稀疏的函授指导来增强向导的立体重建.

blocks.en:
Several concurrent methods condition feed-forward 3D models on external geometric signals: Pow3R [ 10 ] on camera intrinsics, depth, or pose, G-CUT3R [ 14 ] on camera and depth modalities, Rig3R [ 17 ] on multi-camera rig metadata, and Mono3R [ 18 ] on monocular depth.
MapAnything [ 13 ] unifies a flexible mix of conditioning inputs (intrinsics, poses, depth, partial reconstructions) into a single feed-forward model, while Any4D [ 12 ] extends conditional reconstruction to dynamic 4D scenes with multi-modal sensor inputs.
In the depth estimation domain, PromptDA [ 21 ] prompts Depth Anything [ 54 ] with sparse LiDAR points.
All these methods condition on scene-level priors that improve metric accuracy but cannot resolve perceptual aliasing.
To our knowledge, Click3R is the first to introduce correspondence prompting , which conditions feed-forward 3D reconstruction on cross-view point correspondences that directly disambiguate geometric ambiguities, analogous to SAM’s [ 15 , 27 ] click-based segmentation prompting.
blocks.zh:
几种并行方法在外部几何信号上附加了向前提供3D模型的条件:相机内在、深度或姿势上的Pow3R[10];相机和深度模式上的G-CUT3R[14];多相机钻机元数据上的Rig3R[17];单相机深度上的Mono3R[18]。
Map Anything [13] 将调制输入的灵活组合(intrinsics, position, 深度, 部分重建)统一为单一的向导模型,而Any4D [12] 将有条件的重建扩展至动态的4D场景并带有多模式传感器输入.
在深度估计域中,PournalDA [21] 以稀疏的LiDAR点来提示深度的任意动作.
所有这些方法都以场景级别前缀为条件,这些前缀可以提高公分量的准确性,但不能解决知觉别名.
据我们所知, Click3R 是第一个引入 computing 的 computing , 它在 交叉视点 computing -- -- feed-forward 3D -- -- 直接分解出几何模糊性, 与 SAM 的 [ 15, 27] 点击分解 类似。

blocks.en:
Interactive segmentation has a long history of incorporating user guidance into visual recognition.
Early methods use bounding boxes [ 30 ] or scribbles [ 20 ] , while recent approaches adopt click-based prompting [ 51 , 4 , 23 , 39 ] , culminating in SAM [ 15 , 27 ] .
Beyond segmentation, point-based interaction has been extended to image editing: DragGAN [ 26 ] and DragDiffusion [ 37 ] enable users to manipulate content by dragging points.
Recent work has also explored interactive guidance for 3D reconstruction; for example, Toon3D [ 46 ] uses sparse user annotations for cartoon 3D reconstruction.
However, these interactive paradigms have largely remained confined to 2D tasks or stylized 3D settings.
Early interactive systems also explored correspondence-based 3D reconstruction [ 9 ] . Click3R brings this idea to feed-forward stereo models, with point correspondences as geometric constraints rather than semantic cues.
blocks.zh:
互动分解有着将用户指导纳入视觉识别的悠久历史.
早期的方法使用边框 [30] 或拼写 [20] ,而最近的方法则采用以点击为主的提示 [51, 4, 23, 39], 最终形成 SAM [15, 27].
除了分块外,点基交互还被扩展到图像编辑: DragGAN [26]和 DragDifmation [37] 使用户可以通过拖取点来操纵内容.
最近的工作还探索了3D重建的交互式指导;例如,Ton3D[46]在卡通3D重建中使用了稀少的用户说明.
然而,这些交互式范式基本上仍然局限于2D任务或分级的3D设置.
早期的互动系统还探索了基于通信的3D重建[9]. 点击3 R将这个想法带到了向上提供音效的立体模型,以点对等作为几何约束而不是语义提示.

blocks.en: We inject correspondence information into DUSt3R’s decoder using a two-way attention adapter inspired by SAM [ 15 ] , enabling bidirectional exchange between sparse correspondence tokens and dense image tokens ( Figure 2 ).

blocks.en: 4 Hard3DBench
blocks.zh: 4 个 Hard3DBench

blocks.en:
The primary value of Click3R is on challenging scenarios where DUSt3R fails.
Standard evaluations report only aggregate metrics, masking catastrophic failures on geometrically ambiguous scenes.
To enable systematic analysis, we introduce Hard3DBench , a curated benchmark for both 2-view stereo and 5-view multi-view settings, accompanied by a failure taxonomy that exposes the specific failure modes of feed-forward 3D reconstruction.
The 2-view setting contains 404 in-distribution and 300 out-of-distribution pairs, and the 5-view setting 400 in-distribution and 300 out-of-distribution tuples.
In-distribution samples come from held-out test/validation splits of four datasets used to train DUSt3R and Click3R : BlendedMVS [ 56 ] , CO3D [ 28 ] , Habitat [ 32 ] , and WildRGB-D [ 50 ] .
Out-of-distribution samples come from five datasets absent from training: 7Scenes [ 38 ] , DTU [ 11 ] , ETH3D [ 35 ] , NRGBD [ 1 ] , and ScanNet [ 6 ] .
Full curation details are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
Click3R的主要值是DUST3R失败的具有挑战性的情景.
标准评价只报告总指标,掩盖了几何模糊场景的灾难性故障。
为了能够进行系统分析,我们引入了Hard3DBennch ,这是双视立体和多视多视设置的全方位基准,并附有一个故障分类法,揭示了向导3D重建的特定故障模式.
2景区设置有404个分布区和300个出分布区,5景区设置有400个分布区和300个出分布区.
分配样本来自用于训练DUST3R和Click3R的4个数据集的搁置测试/验证分解:BlendedMVS [56],CO3D [28],Habitation [32],和WildRGB-D [50].
分布外样本来自五个没有参加培训的数据集:7Scenes [38],DTU [11],ETH3D [35],NRGBD [1],和ScanNet [6].
详细情况见附录C。

blocks.en: We identify five primary failure modes in the 2-view subset ( Figure 3 ): large viewpoint change ( > 60 ∘ >60^{\circ} ), moderate viewpoint change ( 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} – 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} ), low overlap ( < 20 % <20\% ), large baseline , and extreme depth range . These categories capture geometric conditions that make correspondence estimation and pose recovery difficult, such as reduced visual matches, amplified triangulation error, and increased ambiguity. Since each category is computed from ground-truth poses and depth, challenging pairs can be classified automatically without manual annotation.

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
We compare against state-of-the-art pairwise 3D reconstruction methods: (1) DUSt3R [ 44 ] , the original pretrained model; (2) DUSt3R (re-trained), the same architecture re-trained on the same data as Click3R to isolate the effect of prompting from additional training data; (3) MASt3R [ 16 ] , which extends DUSt3R with dense local feature matching heads; (4) VGGT [ 42 ] , a feed-forward vision foundation model for 3D geometry tasks; and (5) Pi3/Pi3X [ 45 ] , a permutation-equivariant multi-view reconstruction model.
VGGT and Pi3/Pi3X use larger architectures and are trained on much more data, including proprietary internal datasets, with much higher computational budgets. We therefore include them as reference rather than apples-to-apples baselines.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了最先进的双向三维重建方法:(1) DUST3R [44],最初的预训模型;(2) DUST3R(再训练),同样的架构在与 Click3R 相同的数据上重新训练,以隔离从额外培训数据中激发的效果;(3) MASt3R [16],将 DUST3R 扩展为密集的局部特征匹配头;(4) VGGT [42],3D几何任务的向导视觉基础模型;和(5) Pi3/Pi3X [45],永久-等效多视图重建模型.
VGGT和Pi3/Pi3X使用更大的架构,并接受了更多数据的培训,包括专有的内部数据集,计算预算要高得多. 因此,我们把它们作为参考,而不是苹果对苹果的基准。

blocks.en: For standard evaluation, we use held-out splits of three benchmarks: CO3D [ 28 ] , ScanNet++ [ 57 ] , and ARKitScenes [ 2 ] . For each dataset, we sample 1,000 image pairs with a fixed random seed and use the same pairs across all methods. We additionally evaluate on the Hard3DBench benchmark ( Section 5.3 ).

Samples without valid correspondences fall back to the no-prompt result.

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation on Standard Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价标准基准

blocks.en: Table 1 presents results on standard benchmarks. Without prompts, Click3R performs on par with DUSt3R (retrained). Adding even a single well-chosen prompt (1p_best5) consistently improves over the unprompted baseline. The grid oracle reveals substantially larger headroom, with a striking + 8.5 % +8.5\% mAA@30° on ARKitScenes (from 84.27% to 92.75%). This confirms that prompt location matters significantly : the model can leverage even a single correspondence to meaningfully reduce pose error when placed in the right region. Notably, the grid oracle delivers the largest pose gains while pointmap error improves only modestly, indicating that prompts primarily reshape the overall scene configuration rather than uniformly tightening local surface fits.

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation on Hard3DBench
blocks.zh: 5.3 对Hard3DBench的评价

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports results on both the 2-view and 5-view subsets. Click3R consistently improves mAA@30° over the retrained DUSt3R baseline across all four conditions, with the largest gain of + 9.9 +9.9 on the 5-view in-distribution split, and pointmap error also improving in all four conditions.
Notably, these improvements are obtained without increasing input resolution or training data.
These results suggest that even sparse correspondence prompts effectively resolve failure modes in highly ambiguous scenes, enabling the model to recover accurate geometry where fully automatic methods struggle. blocks.en: We compare three training strategies for Click3R : (i) freezing the DUSt3R backbone and training only the adapter, (ii) finetuning DUSt3R jointly with the adapter, and (iii) training the full pipeline from CroCo v2 [ 47 ] initialization. Averaged over the three standard benchmarks and both Hard3DBench 2-view splits with one GT click (Appendix E.1 ), training from CroCo v2 performs best (mAA@30 75.1%), followed by DUSt3R finetuning (72.3%), while freezing DUSt3R gives the weakest results (71.2%). This suggests that Click3R requires substantial end-to-end adaptation to align backbone features with correspondence-conditioned reasoning; training the adapter alone is insufficient.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Click3R , an interactive stereo 3D reconstruction framework that bridges fully automatic feed-forward methods, correspondence-based classical pipelines, and recent prompt-based vision systems.
By injecting sparse point correspondences into a feed-forward stereo 3D reconstruction model through a lightweight correspondence adapter, Click3R enables users to guide the reconstruction process without test-time model fine-tuning or optimization, resolving geometric ambiguities that often cause catastrophic failures.
Experiments on our curated Hard3DBench demonstrate that even a handful of correspondences can dramatically improve reconstruction quality in challenging scenarios.
While Click3R has limitations (Appendix J ) and failure cases (Appendix H ), we hope this work inspires further exploration of correspondence prompting as a promising direction for interactive 3D reconstruction, analogous to how SAM [ 15 ] advanced interactive prompting for 2D segmentation.

我们提出了Click3R, 一个互动的立体声立体重建框架, 它连接了完全自动的向导方法、基于通信的古典管线以及最近的即时视觉系统。
Click3R通过轻量级的通信适配器将稀有的分点函证注入向上立体立体重建模型中,使用户能够在没有测试时间模型微调或优化的情况下引导重建过程,解决常导致灾难性故障的几何模糊.
我们的Hard3DBench的实验表明,即使是少数的通信,在具有挑战性的情况下,也能大大提高重建的质量。
虽然Click3R有限制(附录J)和故障案例(附录H),但我们希望这项工作能激励进一步探索激励作为互动3D重建的有希望方向的函文,类似于SAM[15]如何推进2D分块的交互式提示.

blocks.en:
Click3R follows the DUSt3R [ 44 ] training recipe (loss function, optimizer, data augmentation, symmetric batching) and inherits its CroCo v2 [ 47 ] ViT-Large encoder and dual asymmetric decoder.
Below we detail the components specific to Click3R .

以下详细列出 Click3R 的特定组件 。

blocks.en:
We insert two SAM-style [ 15 ] Two-Way Transformer adapters (depth 2, 8 heads, MLP dim 2048, embedding dim 768) between the encoder and decoder ( Section 3.3 ).
The two adapters share a single correspondence tokenizer ( Section 3.2 ) that encodes each correspondence point as the sum of a positional encoding (random Fourier features [ 15 ] ), an image identity embedding, and a pair identity embedding (vocabulary size 256).
When prompts are provided, the adapted features replace the encoder output; otherwise, the adapter is bypassed and the model reduces to standard DUSt3R.
The adapters and tokenizer are randomly initialized; all other weights are initialized from the CroCo pretrained checkpoint.
All parameters are trained jointly end-to-end.

blocks.en:
We initialize from CroCo v2 [ 47 ] pretrained weights and train all parameters end-to-end, including both the base model and the adapter.
Training uses 4 GPUs, AdamW ( lr = 10 − 4 \text{lr}\!=\!10^{-4} ) with linear warmup and cosine decay.

Both subsets use pretrained DUSt3R’s pose error as the difficulty signal, rather than Click3R or our retrained baseline, so the benchmark is defined independently of the methods under evaluation.
They share the same source datasets: the in-distribution split uses held-out test/val splits of four DUSt3R training datasets, while the out-of-distribution split uses five datasets entirely absent from training ( Table 6 reports the 2-view per-dataset statistics).

blocks.en:
Table 7 reports mAA@30° results broken down by the five failure categories.
Adding sparse correspondence prompts consistently improves performance across all categories.
The largest gains are observed for geometrically challenging cases such as large viewpoint changes (+12.1) and large-baseline pairs (+8.1), where automatic matching is particularly unreliable.
Substantial improvements are also seen for low-overlap pairs (+6.2) and scenes with extreme depth range (+6.6), suggesting that a few well-placed correspondences help stabilize geometric estimation.
Moderate viewpoint changes benefit as well (+4.3), though the baseline model already performs relatively well in this regime.
Overall, prompting improves the aggregate score from 54.6 to 61.7 (+7.1), demonstrating that sparse human-provided correspondences consistently help resolve challenging geometric configurations.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: E.6 Automatic Prompts
blocks.zh: E.6 自动提示

blocks.en: We also consider scenarios without ground-truth correspondences, where we use automatic prompting from RoMa v2 [ 7 ] , a state-of-the-art dense feature matcher. We run it on each image pair, rank its matches by confidence, and greedily select K K of them with a spacing of 10% of the image width in both views, so that the clicks spread over the scene. These clicks improve mAA@30 on all three sets of Table 12 : with K = 4 K\!=\!4 , from 55.9 to 58.0 on the in-distribution pairs, from 49.4 to 59.6 on the out-of-distribution pairs, and from 35.6 to 55.0 on the 100 out-of-distribution pairs with human clicks, close to the human clicks themselves (56.8).
blocks.zh: 我们还考虑没有地面真实通信的情景,我们使用来自RoMa v2 [7]的自动提示,这是最先进的密集特性匹配器. 我们在每个图像对上运行,通过自信来排列其匹配,并贪婪地选择其中的K K,两个视图的相距为图像宽度的10%,这样点击会蔓延到现场. 这些点击在表12的所有三组上改进了mAA@30:用K=4 K\!Q!4,在分配对上从55.9到58.0,在分配对上从49.4到59.6,在分配对上从35.6到55.0,在分配对上从100个有人类点击,靠近人类点击本身(56.8)。

blocks.en: E.7 Transfer to MASt3R
blocks.zh: E.7 转让给MAST3R

blocks.en: As a controlled study of whether correspondence prompting transfers to another backbone, we add the adapter to MASt3R [ 16 ] and train it end-to-end, along with a control without the adapter on the same data. Both are trained on the same nine datasets as Click3R (CO3D, ARKitScenes, ScanNet++, WildRGB-D, BlendedMVS, MegaDepth, Habitat, Waymo, and StaticThings3D), a smaller mixture than the official MASt3R recipe, so their absolute numbers are not comparable with the released model. Test-time clicks raise mAA@30 from 61.1 to 62.4 on the in-distribution pairs and from 52.1 to 54.9 on the out-of-distribution pairs ( Table 13 ), confirming that correspondence clicks also improve performance on a different backbone.
blocks.zh: 作为对函文是否促使转录到另一个主干线的受控研究,我们把适配器添加到MAST3R[16]中并对其进行端到端的训练,同时在同一个数据上有一个没有适配器的控制. 两者在与Click3R相同的9个数据集(CO3D,ARKitScens,ScanNet++,WildRGB-D,BlendedMVS,Mega Depth,Hibody,Waymo,和StaticThings3D)上都接受了训练,这是比官方的MAST3R配方更小的混合物,因此其绝对数与所发布的模型不相上下. 测试时间点击将mAA@30从61.1升至62.4,在分配对上从52.1升至54.9,在分配外对上从52.1升至54.9(表13),证实对应点点击还可以改善不同主干上的表现.

Figure 13 presents additional qualitative comparisons on challenging pairs.

blocks.en: Appendix H Failure Cases
blocks.zh: 附录H 失败案件

blocks.en:
Figure 14 shows four representative failure modes of Click3R .
Each panel shows the input image pair (left), the ground-truth reconstruction (middle), and the Click3R reconstruction with clicks (right).
blocks.zh:
图14显示 Click3R 的四个代表性失败模式 。
每个面板都显示输入图像对(左),地真重建(中),并用点击(右)来显示 Click3R 重建.

blocks.en:
(a) Few overlap. When the two views share little or no visual overlap, the model must hallucinate the relative geometry from appearance alone.
In this ScanNet++ example the views observe disjoint parts of a room; comparing the ground truth with the Click3R output reveals a severely misaligned reconstruction.
Without co-visible content, correspondence clicks cannot anchor the two views—this is a fundamental limitation of pairwise reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
(a) 很少重叠。 当两种观点共享的视觉重叠很少或没有,模型必须从外观上单独地幻出相对几何.
在此 ScanNet++ 示例中, 视图观察到一个房间的不相干部分; 将地面的真相与 Click3R 输出相比较, 揭示出一个严重错配的重建 。
如果没有共同可见的内容,函文点击不能锁定两种观点——这是对等重建的根本限制.

blocks.en:
(b) Heavy rotation. Extreme viewpoint changes ( > 90 ∘ >90^{\circ} ) remain an unsolved challenge.
In this ARKitScenes pair, the Click3R reconstruction remains geometrically distorted compared to the ground truth.
While clicks can reduce error in moderate-rotation cases ( Table 7 ), very heavy rotations overwhelm the model’s capacity to reconcile drastically different visual appearances.
blocks.zh:
(b) 重型轮换。 极端观点的改变( > 90 QQ > 90 QCirc})仍然是一个尚未解决的挑战。
在这个 ARKitScens 配对中,与地面真理相比, Click3R 重建仍然被几何扭曲.
虽然点击可以减少中度旋转情况下的错误(表7),但非常大的旋转会使模型调和明显不同的视觉外观的能力被压倒.

blocks.en:
(c) Large-scale scenes. For outdoor scenes with large spatial extent (MegaDepth), correspondence clicks correctly constrain geometry near the clicked regions, but distant structures still exhibit bending and deformation—visible here as warped sky and distorted building facades far from the click locations.
A small number of clicks cannot regularize the entire scene when the depth range spans tens of meters.
blocks.zh:
(c) 大型场景。 对于具有较大空间范围的户外场景(Mega Depth),函式点击正确约束了被被点击区域附近的几何学,但相距遥远的结构仍然呈现出弯曲和变形——这里作为被扭曲的天空和离被点击地点很远的被扭曲的建筑外观而可见.
当深度跨度为数十米时,少量点击无法使整个场景规范化.

blocks.en:
(d) Ambiguous correspondences. On textureless or repetitive surfaces, correspondences themselves become ambiguous.
In this ARKitScenes bathroom scene with featureless marble walls and white surfaces, a click on one location is visually indistinguishable from many others, providing little geometric information.
The Click3R reconstruction remains distorted compared to the ground truth, and clicks offer negligible improvement.
blocks.zh:
(d) 含糊不清的信件往来。 在无纹理或重复的表面,对应物本身变得模糊.
在这个无地貌大理石墙和白色地表的ARKitScens浴室场景中,点击一个位置在视觉上与许多其他位置无法区分,提供了很少几何信息.
与地面真相相比,Click3R重建仍然被扭曲,点击可以提供可忽略不计的改进.

blocks.en: Appendix J Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录J 限制

blocks.en: Although correspondence prompts are ideally injected into a frozen pretrained model, we find that training the base model [ 44 ] end-to-end with the adapter is necessary in practice, incurring nontrivial training cost. Partly due to this cost, our experiments focus on two-view reconstruction; extending to multi-view models [ 45 , 42 , 53 , 40 ] with trajectory prompts across N N views is an important direction.
blocks.zh: 虽然理想的做法是将函电提示注入被冻结的预先训练的模型中,但我们发现,在实践中需要用适配器来培训基本模型[44]端到端,从而产生非三角训练费用。 部分由于这一成本,我们的实验侧重于双视重建;扩展至多视模型[45,42,53,40],有轨迹提示横跨N视线是一个重要方向.

blocks.en: Architecturally, the adapter treats correspondences as soft feature conditioning via cross-attention rather than enforcing hard geometric constraints. Although eight correspondences suffice to determine relative pose algebraically [ 8 ] , the adapter cannot replicate such reasoning: it modulates all image tokens through learned attention at a single injection point, and this signal is progressively diluted across twelve subsequent decoder cross-attention blocks. Deeper injection at multiple decoder layers and explicit geometric reasoning modules may be worth future inquiry to help close this gap.
blocks.zh: 建筑上,适配器通过交叉意向而非强制硬几何限制,将函文作为软特征调节. 虽然有8个函文足以确定相对的姿势代数 [8],但适配器无法复制这种推理:它通过在单个注入点的被学习到的注意来调制出所有图像符号,这个信号被逐渐地稀释到十二个之后的解码器交叉注意块上. 在多层解码器上进行更深的注射和明确的几何推理模块,可能值得将来的探究来帮助缩小这一差距.

blocks.en: Finally, due to computational constraints, the model is trained only at a resolution of 224 224 px in a stereo setting, although it has demonstrated multi-view capability through global alignment. In addition, prompts must be co-visible in both views, so the two inputs need a shared visible region; non-overlapping inputs could be connected through intermediate views by chaining correspondences. Severely incorrect correspondences can degrade reconstruction quality ( Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 最后,由于计算限制,该模型只在立体声环境下的分辨率为224 224 px得到训练,虽然它通过全球对接表现出多视图能力. 此外,提示必须在两种观点中共同可见,因此两种输入需要共享的可见区域;非重叠输入可以通过连锁通信连接到中间视图. 严重错误的函证会降低重建质量(表11)。

blocks.en: Appendix K Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录 K 更宽的影响

blocks.en: Our work enables more efficient 3D reconstruction from sparse user-provided correspondences. By allowing a small number of clicks to anchor pairwise reconstruction, Click3R can lower the barrier to 3D capture in diverse, in-the-wild scenes, which may benefit downstream applications such as robotics, AR/VR content creation, and scientific imaging where dense ground-truth geometry is unavailable. Our model and benchmark are built from publicly available datasets (CO3D, ScanNet++, ARKitScenes, BlendedMVS, MegaDepth, Habitat, WildRGB-D, Waymo, and standard evaluation benchmarks), and therefore do not raise privacy concerns. While our algorithm itself is scene-agnostic and does not introduce explicit bias, the underlying training datasets may reflect societal or geographic biases present in the source data (e.g., predominantly indoor scenes from North American buildings, or object categories skewed toward consumer products). We encourage future work to investigate and mitigate such biases when deploying systems trained on these data.
